rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=adjoint_max, ram_clamp_output=False, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False, ram_sigma=0.008, ram_factor=0.4, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.42, val_n=200, rationale=iter-12: self-sup finetune REJECTED (val_n=40 3ep -> hr=0.065, corrupts frozen prior). Back to pure inference at anchor. Toggle ram_clamp_output True->False (ONLY knob). Hypothesis: not truncating RAM output at display_max=0.5 preserves breast's sharp high-mu tissue for the two-point calibration, hr>0.2925; if hr drops, clamping stabilizes calibration and I revert.
